crest_factor_status.description: Sample peak / uncentered RMS, including DC; silence is inconclusive.

exact_used_bits.description: Deepest exercised MSB-aligned integer bit; unknown for floats or silence.

effective_bits.description: Reference algorithm: >=500 nonzero samples, threshold max(8, floor(n*1e-4)).

hf_magnitude_ratio.description: Magnitude ratio, matching the Python method; not a power ratio.

noise_above_cutoff_db.description: Unnormalized FFT magnitude reference; not calibrated dBFS.

channel_index.description: None denotes a joint-channel observation such as the stereo MQA scan.

pattern.description: Describes the sampled probes only, not duration coverage or source history.

sync_end_frame.description: Inclusive index of the last sample carrying the 36-bit marker.

source_rate.description: Hypothesis tested, not a verified original recording rate.

zero_excess_score.description: Excess zero-coefficient fraction over off-grid baselines; not probability.

phase_mod_128.description: Offset within each anchor, modulo 128 samples; not an absolute file phase.

anchor_rms.description: RMS of the initial 2048 samples, used only for anchor selection.

lattice_score.description: Mean flagged fraction of all 49 bands at the selected phase/scale, not probability.

phase_offset.description: Offset from each probe's interval start (anchor minus 512), stepped by eight.

scalefactor_index.description: Index 0..7, interpolating 0.3..0.7 of each band's dead-zone scalefactor.

anchor_frame.description: Initial 2048-sample energy window starts here, on the 1024-sample grid.

interval.description: Union of the phase-search windows for this anchor.
Envelope of evaluated STFT frames, excluding unframed tail samples. Active-frame and per-bin gates still exclude observations inside this interval.

modal_scatter_bound_hz.description: Most frequent exact FFT bound bin; ties use the lowest frequency.

phase_frame_pairs.description: Adjacent active STFT pairs with at least two bins above both energy floors.

interval.description: All examined samples, including unframed tails. Prefix boundaries clip runs.

minimum_quiet_run_frames.description: abs(sample) < 0.01 for at least ceil(sample_rate / 2) consecutive samples.

quiet_intervals.description: First sixteen qualifying runs; aggregates include all qualifying runs.

stft_interval.description: Envelope of complete strict-boundary STFT windows, including inactive ones.

quiet_stft_frames.description: Windows wholly inside qualifying quiet runs. Boundaries are never joined.

requested_lower_hz.description: None when no usable channel cutoff exists for the above-cutoff band.

mean_square.description: One-sided, Hann-energy-normalized mean square, averaged over STFT frames.

rms_dbfs.description: 10 log10(mean_square); null for missing data or exact zero power.

coefficient.description: Signed normalized circular correlation of band-masked Hann windows. Energy-weighted across all STFT frames; not full-stream Pearson correlation.

search_limit_frames.description: Maximum prefix considered; block intervals show actual coverage.

level_std_db.description: Population SD of block RMS dBFS; needs >=2 blocks, all above energy floors.

blocks.description: At most 180 completed one-second blocks, with no cross-boundary windows.

block_index.description: Zero-based one-second block in the analyzed prefix.

interval.description: Actual support envelope of complete windows wholly within that second.
Input prefix supplied to the causal filter; at most 180 seconds.

eligible_peak_interval.description: Eligible envelope-peak centers after warmup and both-neighbor exclusions.

baseline_median_lower.description: Bounds from a fixed 0.25-dB histogram, not an exact stored-sample median.

events.description: First 128 accepted peaks; the total count includes all accepted peaks.

frame.description: Native sample index of an envelope local maximum, not an impulse onset.

interval.description: Support envelope of all STFT windows; only active windows contribute.

minimum_bin_amplitude.description: 2 * mean FFT magnitude / sum(Hann), not integrated band RMS.

mean_relative_level_db.description: Mean log magnitude relative to the peak of the active mean spectrum.

interval.description: Envelope of all STFT windows; active_frames exposes the contributing subset.

reference_peak_amplitude.description: 2 * mean FFT magnitude / sum(Hann), not integrated band RMS.

log_magnitude_std_db.description: Only evaluated when frame, geometry and every-bin energy gates pass.

neighbours.description: Signed products at target minus/plus three bins, each with its own status.

coefficient.description: Centered lag product / full-band squared norm; not Pearson correlation.

interval.description: Support envelope of all STFT windows; only active windows contribute.

coefficient.description: Signed Pearson correlation of paired RMS envelopes, not source confidence.

mean_square.description: Mean Hann-normalized band power across active frames.

mean_rms.description: Mean and population SD of the per-frame band RMS envelope.

interval.description: Support envelope of all STFT windows; eligible counts describe selection.

cutoff_p95_hz.description: Existing global cutoff from all active frames, not a per-frame boundary.

fraction.description: Fraction below -95 dB relative to each eligible frame's spectral peak.

interval.description: Complete blocks only; excludes a discarded partial trailing block.

rms_underflow_blocks.description: Nonzero float blocks whose RMS is below the f64 representable range.

nonzero_rms_p015.description: Linear percentiles of nonzero block RMS, not estimated source precision.

selected_blocks.description: Chronological list of the quietest nonzero blocks; at most thirty.

block_index.description: Original zero-based block index, including preceding all-zero blocks.

requested_lower_hz.description: Both requested frequency edges are exclusive.

mean_bin_power.description: One-sided Hann-energy-normalized power, averaged over bins and blocks.

status.description: Integrated-loudness applicability; maxima have independent window counts.

interval.description: Union of complete 400 ms windows; excludes the partial trailing hop.

trailing_frames.description: All frames outside complete windows, including the whole input if short/unsupported.

std.description: Population standard deviation of centered PCM, in full-scale amplitude.

named_tags.description: Named Python fields refer to entries; duplicate text is never copied.

source.description: Source block/chunk, absolute offset and local order preserve provenance.

value.description: None for artwork; its bytes are deliberately not exposed as base64.

total_text_utf8_bytes.description: Counts decoded UTF-8 tag text, including replacements for invalid bytes. Artwork's binary/base64 value is excluded and described separately.

text_scan_complete.description: A negative text search is incomplete if text was omitted or undecodable.

mid_cancelled.description: Exactly zero mid with nonzero native PCM; no source-history implication.

noise_above_cutoff_db.description: Raw FFT magnitude RMS dB, distinct from filtered time-domain void.

legacy_average_bound_hz.description: Unchanged source results, including flat-floor artifacts and gap bridging. Audit only: P05 must use the gated fields above / physical_phase below.

physical_phase.description: Adjacent actual frames, energy-qualified bins >=10 kHz, excludes Nyquist.

probes.description: All planned intervals, including inactive clips and duplicate offsets.

adaptive_wall_hz.description: Depends on P04a resampling and P04b time-domain void; never STFT noise.

legacy_walled_probes.description: Source's silent-only gate/count/majority retained for trace, not a verdict.

legacy_verdict.description: Pinned wording for audit only; it is not a validated diagnosis.
Pinned clipping wording for audit only, not proof of audible distortion.

legacy_display.description: The reference's EOF marker is retained only in this audit field.

percentile_rms.description: Linear interpolation on strictly positive complete-block RMS amplitudes.

legacy_loudness_profile.description: Pinned last printed astats selection; crest_factor_db is raw linear here.

legacy_text.description: Tool-precision text, including nonfinite/omitted legacy results.

legacy_python_label.description: Pinned Python selects the first positive-only matching channel text.

legacy_outputs.description: Exact pinned tuple on finite valid inputs. Raw wording is audit-only.

power_db.description: Time-major, then DC-to-Nyquist. Floor applied after linear-power averaging.

interval.description: Display bucket, in native PCM frames; final bucket extends to analyzed end.

window_support.description: Actual overlapping FFT window support (which can extend beyond the bucket).
